_doc: Roach v2 — operator-tunable config. Wallet/strategyId/chatId resolved from runtime YAML env vars; do NOT hardcode here. Producer reads only the entry/striker thresholds (informational fallback if scanner.py is run standalone). Risk gates, leverage caps, and asset cooldowns are enforced by the runtime via runtime.yaml and the producer's hardcoded constants.

leverage._note: Default 7x. Override per-deploy via ROACH_LEVERAGE env var. v1.1 capped at 7 (10x fee burn was material on 506 fills).

marginUsd._note: Default $250/slot. Override per-deploy via ROACH_MARGIN_USD env var. Designed for ~$1k starting budget × 2 slots × 25% margin.

striker._note: These mirror roach-producer.py's hardcoded constants. Producer constants WIN — config is informational/audit only in v2.

entry._stalker_disabled: Stalker permanently removed from v2. Fox v1.0 data: 17 Stalker trades, 17.6% WR, -$91.32 net. The one Striker (ZEC LONG score 11) was the only profitable explosive entry. Roach is the experimental confirmation that fewer + higher quality beats more + mixed.

_runtime_owns._doc: These were v1 concerns. In v2, the runtime owns them via runtime.yaml.guard_rails. DO NOT add gates here.
